question:
"I'm a big fan of a dating reality show. One of the co-hosts was a former teen beauty pageant winner and hosted MTV's "Total Request Live" in the mid-2000s. The show requires participants to form relationships and get engaged through cubicle conversations without ever meeting each other. I'd like to know which couples from seasons 1 through 7 married. Please list them as "[male name] & [female name]." As of the end of June 2025, how many of these couples are still together and how many have divorced?If more than one couple wed in the same season, put each one on its own line.

Please organize the results in one Markdown table with the following column names in order:
Season, Couple married at the show, Status
As for the Status column, just give the information of ""Still Married"", or ""Divorced""

Don't ask me any questions, just output the results according to the columns without omitting cells arbitrarily. The output format is ```markdown
{data_content}
```."
